task: Get owner-financing homesite land for sale in New Mexico, Luna County,  listed in the last 30 days, and contact the cheapest per acre land seller.
agent_final_answer: Task completed. On LandWatch I filtered Luna County, New Mexico land for sale by Property Type = Homesite, Owner Financing = Yes, and Date Listed = Past 30 days, which returned 28 listings. Sorting by "Price per Acre: Low to High" placed the cheapest per acre listing first: $100 for 2 Acres (about $50/acre) at Coyote Rd, Akela, NM 88030, Luna County, listed by Sarah Norton of Frisco Valley Land (phone (575) 570-8656). I contacted this seller via the "Contact Seller" form (Name: Han Wang, Email: han.wang.2718@gmail.com, Phone: 5055550123, with a message asking about the owner-financing terms). The site confirmed "Message sent! Sarah Norton will reply to you directly."
